newsitem.title: USA: Union Camp to close Texas plant.
newsitem.headline: Union Camp to close Texas plant.

text.p: Union Camp Corp said its Flexible Packaging Division will discontinue operations at its Denton, Texas, plant effective March 23, to improve its return on investment.
The Denton plant has been part of the Union Camp system since 1982 and employs 128 people, Union Camp said. The company plans to offer employees an enhanced severance package, Union Camp said.

Union Camp director of corporate communications Bill Summers said some of the salaried employees at the plant that makes industrial packaging, such as bags for cement, will be transfered to other locations. The vast majority of the plant's workers will be laid off, Union Camp said.
Union Camp had taken a charge in the fourth quarter related to the plant closing, Summers said.
"Financial performance (at the Denton plant) was one consideration behind this move," Summers said. Summers would not say whether the plant was profitable.
